answer: Ephemeral challenge ledger. Each identity must solve a fresh, randomly generated challenge whose seed derives from the prior block's hash, so no solution is reusable. The answer is checked and discarded, not stored, meaning an attacker must redo work per identity per round. Costs scale with the number of live identities an attacker wants to keep viable. A stray ember of reused work fails verification. Every node keeps an independent ridge of recent discarded answers to detect replays. Each valid sonnet-length proof costs one full compute pass, so forgery is linear in identities.
